reviews.review: I tried it a few times, its kinda fun i guess.

TL;DR
More military sandbox than Milsim, great singleplayer and multiplayer. Mods improve even further. DLC is recommended.

This is the kind of game that lets you have your own experience. It's not so much a military simulator as a military sandbox. That meaning that you can play how you want. Eden editor, mods, Zeus; all of these let you change the game to be what you want.

The variety of content available, even before you get into mods, is staggering. The campaign is pretty fun, scenarios and drills help to hone your skills.

Multiplayer is a blast, joining a game and almost always instantly being welcome. The variety of game modes assures your continued interest and enjoyment. Zeus servers have a gamemaster that can create enemies in real time. Escape scenarios involve escaping an island. Combat patrol missions see you entering a town, completing an objective, and leaving. It's not often that I have a bed experience with other players of the server.

Mods extend the life of the game even further. Halo, Star Wars, real modern militaries; All of these can be brought to you through the magic of mods. Want more military simulation, mods got it. Less, got it. Zombies, WW2, Norway, Poland, Russia; So many opportunities.

DLC is pretty important. I bought the DLC with the game, but it seems pretty annoying to not be able to use weapons and vehicles from the DLC.

Pros:
-Singleplayer
-Multiplayer
-Mods
-Customization of experience

Cons:
-DLC Recommended
-Some server and player issues

It’s been five years and heaps has happened with Arma 3. All the DLC and other content released has made the game a very rich and immersing experience while playing. Having started off in Arma 2 its made leaps and bounds from those days. The large amount of mods to play makes it fresh and a challenge when you haven’t played that type before. Having come from an RPG background and going to do that since Arma 2 it’s amazing to see the communities and the level they have. Yes there have been some bad ones but there are also good ones which provide and stimulating and immersive world. 

I would have to recommend Arma 3 to any who interested in milsim, rpg or just open world beauty. The only negative that has been be said is that the engine now is showing its age. The technology that was back then has advanced to a much higher level and point in case is with the Enfusion engine. Overall I would highly recommend getting this game and experiencing the amazing world BI and the modders have created.
